documents.population: Bachelor's applicants with a foreign upper secondary qualification
documents.notes: Fact sheet 'Documents to Submit, Bachelor's Program, Foreign Qualification' (dated 01.07.2026; the date is the sheet's version, not an academic year). Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): signed declaration of consent; proof of sufficient skills in German (UZH Bachelor's teaching is in German; 'All persons with a visa requirement must submit a language certificate'); official proof of admission to study the subject at a recognized university in the country of the school-leaving certificate (depending on the qualification). IB holders send the DP transcript from the IBO instead of the school reports; British-system applicants send their board certificates.
